title: Loyalty Reduction on Lapsed Renewals — Northgate Memberships
content:
Northgate Memberships rewards long membership history when an expired membership is renewed. The loyalty reduction is taken off the renewal fee of a lapsed membership according to the membership's paid membership years.

**Paid membership years.** The paid membership years of a membership are counted as its new membership and renewal fee charges on the membership ledger, less every charge that was refunded as a duplicate charge.

## Loyalty schedule

| Paid membership years | Loyalty reduction taken off the renewal fee of a lapsed membership |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 8 percent of the annual fee of the tier the new membership year is held at, rounded to the cent |
| 5 to 9 | a flat 4.50 dollars |
| fewer than 5 | none |

## Boundaries

- 4 paid membership years: no reduction. 5 paid years: 4.50 dollars.
- 9 paid membership years: 4.50 dollars. 10 paid years: 8 percent of the annual fee of the tier the new year is held at.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Paid years | Annual fee of the tier the new year is held at | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 130.00 | 8 percent of 130.00, that is 10.40 |
| 10 | 45.50 | 8 percent of 45.50, that is 3.64 |
| 11 | 32.50 | 8 percent of 32.50, that is 2.60 |
| 7 | any | 4.50 |
| 3 | any | none |

*Counting example (hypothetical):* a ledger holding one new membership fee and ten renewal fees, one of the renewal fees having been refunded as a duplicate charge, shows 11 charges less 1, that is 10 paid membership years.
